hero.eyebrow: Senior Analytics Engineer / Senior Auditor — SQL · Python · Power BI · Microsoft Cloud Services
hero.headline: Turning audit findings into systems that catch problems before they're findings.
hero.lede: Senior Auditor specializing in audit analytics, data engineering, and business intelligence, with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Power BI, and Microsoft cloud services across banking and regulated environments. Builds end-to-end analytics solutions — from data extraction and validation to dashboards highlighting exceptions, control gaps, and performance risks.

paragraphs: I'm a Senior Auditor at Bank of Commerce, where I support audit and business reviews by extracting, cleaning, and validating banking data using SQL and Python — turning raw tables into analysis-ready datasets with documentation and quality checks. I build Power BI dashboards and recurring MI reports that help stakeholders spot anomalies, control gaps, and performance issues.

Before this, I worked across healthcare analytics (Proview Global), sales/inventory reporting (Scriptmed), and earlier internship roles in valuation advisory and banking, giving me a broad base in translating business requirements into data-driven reports.

I also co-founded Infoseer Consulting, a data analytics and AI consultancy helping Philippine businesses use their data to make better decisions — where I lead client relationships and business strategy.

I'm completing a Master in Applied Business Analytics at the University of Asia & the Pacific (2024–2026), building on my BS in Business Administration, specialized in Business Analytics, from the same university.
